title: Cambridge IELTS 21 Test 3 Writing Task 1
prompt: Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
directions:
You should spend about 20 minutes on this task.

Write at least 150 words.

scenario: The diagram below shows how one type of desert, known as a rain-shadow desert, is formed.
requirements: Select and report the main features.

visualData.title: The formation of rain-shadow deserts
notes: The diagram shows moist coastal air rising and cooling on the windward side of a mountain, rain falling, and dry air continuing over the mountain to form a rain-shadow desert inland.
